lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: しょう、本当、上手、なった。
lines.en: Sho, you've really gotten so skilled.
lines.style: Soft opening, genuine admiration. Warm and unhurried. Ren's voice carries real affection — not performing it. Steady eye contact, almost tender.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I try hard every single day.
lines.style: Small, quiet voice. Matter-of-fact but with an undertone of pride. Sho states it simply, no embellishment. Genuine warmth in the steadiness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: I'll keep cheering you on. Always.
lines.style: Gentle promise. Ren leans into the words with quiet conviction. Warm but not effusive — the weight is in the reliability, not the volume.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Small, genuine delight. Sho's voice opens up slightly — he means this. No performance, just real warmth. A simple statement of something that matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: Keep trying hard. For as long as you can.
lines.style: Ren's voice deepens slightly with sincerity. No rush. The words land with quiet weight — this is real encouragement, not hollow praise. Warm close.
